text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick note  Omar joins as Eng Manager next Mon 09:30 PT. Tying up a compact manager onboarding checklist + a couple of non-standard asks (budget access + 1:1 note template). Please confirm by EOD Fri.

Maya (People Ops): Day-before essentials (short):
- Device shipped + imaged
- Okta invite + MFA link sent
- Email + Slack + calendar provisioned
- Notion access to /team/eng/managers and hiring folder
- 1Password manager vault access granted
- Welcome email with week-1 agenda sent

Casey (Eng): I can be Omar's buddy. I also have a short "first-PR" onboarding task to give them a hands-on win.

Nina (IT): Device imaged (MBA). Shipping label created. Will add Docker, VSCode, VPN, and set up the dev kube group `eng-dev`. Quick Q: Omar needs budget-tool access (Concur) too?

Ravi (People Ops): Good catch. Please add Concur access for managers; we grant it after payroll setup. I'll trigger that.

Maya (People Ops): Extra manager items (non-standard):
- Grant access to team "spot budget" (Concur) for small event/coffee reimbursements
- Share 1:1 note template (we use a lightweight goals + blockers + kudos format)
- Block a "skip-level cafe" 30m on Fri so team can meet informally

Casey (Eng): Love the skip-level cafe. Also recommend a 20m "budget primer" with finance for new managers in week 1. Helps hiring/contract questions.

Nina (IT): :white_check_mark: Device imaged & shipped. Added `eng-dev`. Will add Concur once Ravi confirms approval.

Ravi (People Ops): :white_check_mark: Concur approval created. Sent welcome email draft to Maya for review.

Maya (People Ops): Week-1 manager rhythm (copyable):
Mon: 09:30 quick ops + logistics (10m), 10:00 team kickoff (30m), 15:00 director 1:1 (30m)
Tue: buddy shadow + infra & repo walkthrough (60m)
Wed: PM & product context (30m), 20m team norms w/ tech leads
Thu: draft 30/60/90 + hiring touchpoint (45m)
Fri: skip-level cafe (30m) + week1 retro (20m) + finance budget primer (20m)

Omar (new-manager): Thanks all  one small ask: can someone give me the short template for 1:1 notes and the hiring rubric link? I want to prep before Thu.

Casey (Eng): Dropping 1:1 template in Notion and linking hiring rubric now. Will add the first-PR task to the onboarding page.

Maya (People Ops): Please react with :white_check_mark: when your pieces are done so I can close the checklist. Ill publish the consolidated Notion page and DM Omar the week-1 calendar + links.

onboard-bot: Reminder set: "Omar 4 prestart checklist" Fri 17:00 PT.
